country_event = {
	id = lr_power.1
	title = lr_power.1.t
	desc = {
		text = lr_power.1.d_a
		trigger = { check_variable = { LR_pw < 50 } }
	}
	desc = {
		text = lr_power.1.d_b
		trigger = { check_variable = { LR_pw > 49 } }
	}
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_rally
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = lr_power.1.a
		add_political_power = 50
		add_stability = -0.05
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { LR_pw < 50 } }
			set_variable = { LR_pw = 20 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { LR_pw = 80 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = lr_power.1.b
		add_stability = -0.1
		add_war_support = 0.03
		set_variable = { LR_pw = 50 }
	}
}
